Author: Vipin Chandra Dixit
Bench: Vipin Chandra Dixit
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 92
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 26973 of 2022
Applicant :- Rohit

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State Of U.P.And Another Counsel for Applicant :- Awadhesh Kumar
Pandey

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vipin Chandra Dixit,J.
Supplementary affidavit filed today is taken on record.
As per office report dated 03.08.2022, notice has been personally served upon opposite party no. 2 but no one is present on behalf of opposite party no. 2.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.
It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present case.

It is further submitted that the informant as well as the victim have appeared before the trial court and their statements were recorded as PW-1 and PW-2, wherein they have not levelled any allegation against the applicant and they have become hostile.
The certified copy of statements of PW-1 and PW-2 have been annexed as Annexure No. SA-1 and SA-2 to the supplementary affidavit, filed today.
Since, informant and victim have become hostile during trial, as such, no conviction is possible in this case.

Learned counsel for the applicant has further submitted that the applicant has no previous criminal history and there is no possibility of fleeing Rohit vs State Of U.P.And Another on 20 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/176272320/
1 away from the judicial process or tampering with the witnesses and in case, the applicant is enlarged on bail, the applicant shall not misuse the liberty of bail.

entities.text: Rohit vs State Of U.P.And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The applicant is in jail since 04.03.2022.
Learned A.G.A. for the State vehemently opposed the prayer of bail.
However, he does not dispute the aforesaid facts.

Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties, from perusal of the record and considering the complicity of accused, severity of punishment as well as totality of facts and circumstances, at this stage, without commenting on the merits of the case, I find it a fit case for bail.
The bail application is allowed.

Let the applicant Rohit be released on bail in Case Crime No. 87 of 2022, under Sections 363, 366,
376 I.P.C. & Section 3/4 P.O.C.S.O. Act, registered at Police Station Bahjoi, District Sambhal, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Court concerned, subject to the following conditions:
(i) The applicant will not tamper with prosecution evidence and will not harm or harass the victim / complainant in any manner whatsoever.
(ii) The applicant will abide by the orders of the court, will attend the court on every date and will not delay the disposal of trial in any manner whatsoever.
(iii) The applicant will not indulge in any unlawful activity.
(iv) The applicant will not misuse the liberty of bail in any manner whatsoever.

The identity, status and residential proof of sureties will be verified by the court concerned and in case of breach of any of the conditions mentioned above, court concerned will be at liberty to cancel the bail and send the applicant to prison.
